VaultConfig.title: VaultConfig
VaultConfig.description: End-to-end encrypted key wrapping and 2FA security metadata for a counselor.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the counselor.

pinHash.description: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 hash of the counselor 6-digit security PIN.

kdfSalt.description: Base64-encoded 16-byte salt used for key derivation.

wrappedMasterKeyIv.description: Base64 IV for wrapped master E2EE key.

totpEnabled.description: Whether RFC 6238 TOTP second-factor verification is enabled.

wrappedTotpSecret.description: Optional AES-256-GCM wrapped TOTP shared secret.

wrappedTotpIv.description: Optional Base64 IV for wrapped TOTP secret.

recoveryCodeHash.description: Optional SHA-256 hash of the emergency recovery code.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when vault config was created (client writes FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when vault config was last updated (client writes FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CounselingRecord.title: CounselingRecord
CounselingRecord.description: End-to-end encrypted counseling session or counselor activity diary record.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owning counselor.

category.description: Type of counseling session or counselor activity.

sessionDateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of the session or activity date.

dayName.description: Day of the week in Malay (e.g., Isnin).

durationMinutes.description: Duration of the session or activity in minutes.

hasAiSummary.description: Whether the record contains an AI-generated or finalized summary.

encryptedPayload.description: Base64 AES-256-GCM encrypted JSON containing clientName, className, notes, and summary fields.

payloadIv.description: Base64 12-byte GCM initialization vector for encryptedPayload.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when record was created (client writes FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when record was last updated (client writes FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/security/{configId}.description: Per-user E2EE vault configuration and 2FA key wrapping metadata.

/users/{userId}/records/{recordId}.description: Per-user end-to-end encrypted counseling sessions and activity diary records.
